A01: Taking all things together, how would you say things are these days-would you say you're very happy, pretty happy, or not too happy these days?

A02: Some people think a lot about the social problems of the nation and the world, and about how they might be solved. Others spend little time thinking about these issues. How much do you think about such things?

A03: The next questions ask your opinions about a number of different topics. How much do you agree or disagree with each statement below? A03a: Men and women should be paid the same money if they do the same work
A03b: Women should be considered as seriously as men for jobs as executives or politicians
A03c: A woman should have exactly the same job opportunities as a man
A03d: A woman should have exactly the same educational opportunities as a man
A03e: It is usually better for everyone involved if the man is the achiever outside the home and the woman takes care of the home and family
A03f: A preschool child is likely to suffer if the mother works
A03g: A working mother can establish just as warm and secure a relationship with her children as a mother who does not work

A04: The next questions are about pollution and the environment. How much do you agree or disagree with each statement below? A04a: Pollution of most types has increased in the U.S. in the last ten years
A04b: Government should take steps to deal with our environmental problems, even if it means that most of us pay higher prices or taxes
A04c: I would prefer to pay more money for things that will last a long time, rather than have them cost less and break sooner
A04d: I would probably be willing to use a bicycle or mass transit (if available) rather than a car to get to work
A04e: I would be willing to eat less meat and more grains and vegetables, if it would help provide food for starving people

B10: Amphetamines have been prescribed by doctors to help people lose weight or to give people more energy. They are sometimes called uppers, ups, speed, bennies, dexies, pep pills, and diet pills. Amphetamines do NOT include any non-prescription drugs, such as over-the-counter diet pills (like Dexatrim (R)), or stay-awake pills (like No-Doz (R)), or any mail-order drugs.
